_comment: Data for eotg_lint rule L013 (loc house style, owner's loc review 2026-10-04). Edit freely; no code change needed. Regexes are Python 're' syntax, matched as whole words, case-insensitively, against the visible text of a value ([functions], $KEYS$ and #formatting removed). See docs/tools/eotg_lint.md, L013. | HOUSE STANDARD IS CANADIAN ENGLISH (owner, 2026-10-04): -our/-re/-ce nouns and grey/catalogue are correct; -ize, program, analyze, plow are the Canadian forms. Interim list; cloud round 7 rebuilds this as an American-form + -ise checker with fixtures.

dashes.why: The owner removed every em and en dash from mod prose; use a comma, colon, full stop or parentheses.

british._ise_note: An -ise word is flagged unless its base form (the word with -ed/-es/-ing/-ation(s) turned back into -e) is in ise_exceptions. Add words here, not to the code.
british._exceptions_note: Literal strings (proper nouns, fixed names) blanked out before matching.
british.why: House standard is Canadian English (Oxford -ize with British -our, -re, -ll-).

whitespace.why: Doubled or edge spaces render as visible gaps or misalign concatenated descs.

append.why: A desc appended after the opener (triggered_desc in a desc = { } concatenation) must open its own paragraph, or it runs into the previous sentence.
